what: a steel hoe: the blade of cool blue-grey forged steel, darker and cooler than iron, with a bright white edge highlight, a gold collar, the long handle wrapped in red-brown leather with gold cross-bands and a round gold pommel. Same shape as the attached iron hoe: at the handle's top a short neck reaches out to ONE side (the upper left) and a flat blade turns down from it, an L, never a T; nothing past the handle on the other side. 2 px margin; no straight vertical edge
